evidence: The elemental composition of the GZO films was determined with a Bruker Quantax energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS) equipped on a JEOL JSM25 SIII scanning electron microscope (SEM). Hall measurements were carried out at room temperature on GZO coated dies using In contacts in Van der Pauw configuration. The thickness of the samples was measured with a Dektak profilometer. The high resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) observation of the interface was performed by a JEOL JEM-3010 instrument. X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were performed with a Bruker AXS D8 Discover diffractometer. Depth profiles were measured by an INA-X type secondary neutral mass spectrometer (SNMS) equipment by Specs GmbH, Berlin. The speciﬁc resistivity and Hall mobility were calculated using these measured thickness values.
